metadata.title: Clicked like a potato and somehow dragged that 1 poor soul to uninstall? Valorant madness!
metadata.description:
Clicked like I was trying to close a popup.
That 1 kill probably shattered a keyboard.
Did NOT deserve that but chaos picked me today.
If your aim’s a happy accident, this is your anthem.

Tap if your aim’s a beautiful disaster!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
